Kid ASA - Revenues for the Second Quarter of 2026 Wed, Jul 08, 2026 07:30 CET Lier, 8 July 2026: Kid ASA today announces unaudited revenue figures for the second quarter of 2026 (previous year in parentheses). For definition of like-for-like sales, please see latest quarterly report at www.investor.kid.no. KID GROUP Q2 revenues increased by +9.1% (+5.0%) to MNOK 914.8 (MNOK 838.7[1]). Like-for-like sales increased by +8.3%[2,3] (+4.6%). Online sales accounted for 15.9% (12.2%[2]) of total revenues in the quarter. For the first six months of 2026, Group revenues increased by +8.6% (+4.7%) to MNOK 1,715.3 (MNOK 1,579.3[4]). Like-for-like sales increased by +7.3%[2,3] (+3.8%). SEGMENT KID INTERIOR Q2 revenues increased by +7.1% (+7.1%) to MNOK 574.3 (MNOK 535.9). Like-for-like sales increased by +6.7% (+5.7%). Online sales increased by +48.7% (+2.8%). For the first six months of 2026, revenues increased by +8.0% (+5.4%) to MNOK 1,066.9 (MNOK 988.3). Like-for-like sales increased by +7.0% (+3.9%). Online sales increased by +34.9% (+3.1%). Three stores were refurbished and one store was closed during the quarter. There were no new or relocated stores. The total number of physical stores at the end of the quarter was 161 (159). The number of shopping days in the quarter was 72 (71). SEGMENT HEMTEX Q2 revenues increased by +12.5% (+1.7%) to MSEK 338.3 (MSEK 300.8). Like-for-like sales increased by +11.4% (+2.7%)[3]. Online sales increased by +36.4% (+9.9%). For the first six months of 2026, revenues increased by +9.7% (+3.7%) to MSEK 627.5 (MSEK 572.0). Like-for-like sales increased by +7.9%[3] (+3.7%). Online sales increased by +34.2% (+10.6%). Two stores were closed, one store was relocated and one store was refurbished during the quarter. There were no new stores. The total number of physical stores at the end of the quarter was 122 (123)[5]. The number of shopping days in the quarter was 90 (90). The quarterly report for the second quarter of 2026 will be announced 20 August 2026 at CEST 07:30.

posts.text: 20. aug. Solid betring.  •  Revenues for the Group increased by 6.8% to MNOK 914.8 (9.1% in constant  currency), supported by strong seasonal assortments and solid LFL sales growth • Gross margin increased to 63.2% (62.3%), reflecting favourable freight costs,  currency effects and product mix • OPEX increased by 5.4% (+13.7%) impacted by increased marketing, bonus accruals and IT investments, partly offset by non-recurring items in Q2 2025 • EBITDA increased by 15.2% to MNOK 217.8 (MNOK 189.1), up MNOK 28.7 yearover-year • EPS increased by NOK 0.97 to NOK 0.90 • Operating cash flow improved by MNOK 103.8 compared with Q2 2025, supported by improved working capital development and higher profitability
